title: The Wrong Bell
author: P. M. Oyelaran
blurb: Juniper Vane, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
